what_this_is: the first E1 development pilot: three learning regimes on one public task; it does not confirm H1, does not select a universal model and does not replace the benchmark of the proposal (families/comparators stay pending in the matrix)

task.reach_measured_by: perturbation and gradient per input row (tools/df_e1_receiver.py), not asserted
task.reach_note: ARCH-A with the sequence fusion depends on the last `model_reach_steps` samples of the window (branch 5 + core 3 - 1); the window is the declared context, the reach is what the prediction can depend on (RP28: full real reach declared)

dev_subpartition.rows_note: the last 28 days of the family's train split and the first 7 days of its validation split (family train end row 1452681); test rows never read

graph.core: causal dilated Conv1D stack with dilations [1, 2, 4, 8, 16] (kernel 3, 16 filters, residual), reach 60 positions: derived from W, not searched
graph.grouping: held constant: physical groups (power: active history, reactive, intensity | voltage | sub-metering 1-3); profile-based grouping is a separate factor not varied here

layers.detector (per branch): 2 residual causal Conv1D blocks: Conv1D(16, k=3, d=1, ELU) + 1x1 projection skip
layers.core: Conv1D(16, k=3, causal, ELU) on the channel-concatenated branch sequences, last position
layers.head: Dense(p) increment over the last observation (persistence skip); the target channel is read out
layers.readout: the model output at the target's input channel; only that channel is trained and scored

graph.initial_weights: keras set_random_seed(seed) before build: the SAME initial checkpoint for R0/R1/R2 of a seed (digest recorded per unit)

regimes.R1: detector from ae_s (masked AE, train windows only), frozen
regimes.R2: detector from ae_s, adjustable (same imported weights as R1)

pretraining.objective: masked reconstruction (mask ratio 0.30 of time x channel positions) on DEV TRAIN windows; the internal validation is a PURGED TAIL of those same train origins, so the supervised DEV validation is never consumed by pre-training; decoder separate and never connected at inference
pretraining.internal_validation_purge: window + horizon rows between the pre-training origins and the internal validation ones
pretraining.validation_mask_policy: FIXED BANK by window identity for validation; epoch-varying noise for training, as declared

training.epoch_note: an epoch is one pass over the DEV train origins in batches; the update counter binds exactly
training.same_task_budget: every regime gets the same update ceiling; the AE cost is reported apart and added for the total-cost reading

controls.linear_ridge: ridge (lambda 1.0 x n_train on standardised inputs) on the flattened scaled window (W x p) + bias, fitted on DEV train windows
controls.linear_reach: the same ridge on the last `model_reach_steps` rows only: the information a local receiver can use

support.persistence: one sample: the target's last observation (inside every receiver's reach)
support.seasonal_naive_daily: the target one day before the target row: OUTSIDE the context window; a HIGHER-INFORMATION reference, not an equal-information peer
support.linear_ridge: the whole window (W x p): the same information the declared context gives
support.linear_reach: the last `model_reach_steps` rows of the window: the same information a local receiver can use

metrics.mae: kW on the common evaluation set
metrics.mase: MAE / mean |y(t+h) - y(t)| over DEV train origins (persistence at the horizon)
metrics.common_evaluation_set: DEV validation origins admissible for the model AND with a finite label AND a finite daily lookup; identical for every unit
metrics.test: NOT SCORED (the benchmark's final test stays unscored)

replicas.pairing: R0/R1/R2 of a seed share the initial checkpoint; R1/R2 share the AE of the seed
replicas.purpose: optimisation variability, not a power calculation

budget.rule: projection = sum over remaining units of (seconds/update x update ceiling + overhead) x (1 + headroom); if spent + projection exceeds the ceiling the pilot stops BUDGET_LIMITED before any outcome (arms/seeds are never cut after results)

governance.why: the deployed data-gov serves no lake holding the public panels; DATASETS campaigns complete units only through deliveries of every declared dataset; SYNTHETIC would misdeclare real bytes
governance.missing_object: one lake registration of public_panels_c126_v2 in data-gov (config + service restart: an owner action)
governance.what_is_recorded: governed_terminal.v1 documents per unit in the run root + CAMPAIGN_PROPOSAL.json
